verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon, including the first woman and person of color, to establish a long-term presence and prepare for Mars.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'send astronauts... to explore more of the Moon... foundation for the first crewed missions to Mars'; R4: 'land the first woman and the next man... establish a human outpost... for future missions to Mars'; R7: 'returning humans to the Moon... permanent base... stepping stone to human missions to deeper space'; R8: 'land humans on the Moon... first woman and first person of colour... sustained lunar presence'; R9: 'land the first woman and the first person of colour... sustainable lunar presence... preparing for Mars'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the program's goals of returning humans to the Moon (first woman/person of color), long-term presence, and Mars preparation.

verifications.claim: Artemis I was a successful uncrewed mission in 2022.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Artemis I Launched in 2022... first in a series'; R4: 'Artemis I... Uncrewed Test Flight (2022-2023)... successfully launched in late 2022'; R5: 'Artemis I... launch on November 16, 2022'; R6: 'Artemis I mission in November 2022'; R7: 'Artemis I (November 16, 2022) was the first uncrewed test flight'; R8: 'Artemis I (2022) was an uncrewed test'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm Artemis I as uncrewed, launched in 2022, and successful.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby planned for 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II mission, the first crewed journey around the Moon'; R2: 'Artemis II The first crewed Artemis flight'; R6: 'Artemis II (April 1–11, 2026) was a crewed lunar flyby mission'; R7: 'Artemis II (April 1, 2026) was a crewed lunar flyby'; R8: 'Artemis II marked the first crewed lunar flyby'; R10: 'Artemis II... launch... no earlier than April 2026... around the far side of the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: References consistently describe Artemis II as crewed lunar flyby/orbit in 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis III/IV are planned landings starting in 2027-2028.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Artemis III Scheduled for 2027... test one or both commercial landers [in low Earth orbit]... Artemis IV... early 2028 for the first Artemis lunar landing'; R6: 'Artemis III (mid-2027)... test rendezvous... in Earth orbit... Artemis IV (early 2028)... first lunar landing'; R7: 'Artemis III (mid-2027)... test of HLS in low Earth orbit... Artemis IV (early 2028)... first lunar landing'; R8: 'Artemis III... low-Earth orbit to dock... Artemis IV aims to land'
verifications.reasoning: References specify Artemis III as Earth orbit demo (not landing) in 2027; first landing is Artemis IV in 2028. Claim incorrectly attributes landings to III/IV starting 2027.
